title: IC Package Record
description: Structured package-record schema with categorized properties and JEDEC BGA terminology.

bgaTerminology.description: Definitions from JEDEC JEP95 Design Guide 4.7 and Design Guide 4.17.

A.const: Distance from the seating plane to the highest point of the package body.

A1.const: Vertical distance from the seating plane to the lowest point of the package body.

A2.const: Thickness of the package body excluding ball height.

b.const: Ball diameter measured in a plane parallel to the seating plane.

b1.const: Diameter of the solderable substrate surface.

D.const: Body dimension parallel to the major axis of the ball matrix.

E.const: Body dimension parallel to the minor axis of the ball matrix.

D1.const: Distance between the centerlines of the two outermost ball rows perpendicular to the major axis.

E1.const: Distance between the centerlines of the two outermost ball rows perpendicular to the minor axis.

e.const: Distance between adjacent ball centerlines when the major- and minor-axis pitches are equal.

eD.const: Distance between adjacent ball centerlines in the major-axis direction.

eE.const: Distance between adjacent ball centerlines in the minor-axis direction.

MD.const: Number of balls in a fully populated row parallel to the major axis.

ME.const: Number of balls in a fully populated row parallel to the minor axis.

n.const: Actual number of balls, excluding depopulated locations.

SD.const: Distance from the centermost ball row or column to datum A.

SE.const: Distance from the centermost ball row or column to datum B.

aaa.const: Tolerance controlling the profile and orientation of the package-body sides.

bbb.const: Tolerance controlling parallelism of the package top surface to seating-plane datum C.

ccc.const: Unidirectional profile tolerance controlling ball coplanarity relative to seating-plane datum C.

ddd.const: Cylindrical true-position tolerance controlling the ball pattern relative to datums A and B.

eee.const: Cylindrical tolerance controlling relative ball positions within the matrix.

seating_plane.const: Plane defined by the crowns of at least three non-collinear supporting balls.

datum_A.const: Axis of the feature defined by dimension D.

datum_B.const: Axis of the feature defined by dimension E.

datum_C.const: The seating plane used as the primary measurement reference.

depopulation.const: Omission of balls from a full MD by ME matrix.

ball_height.const: Perpendicular distance from the package substrate to the apex of a ball.

standoff.const: Distance between the package body and the seating plane.

mounting_height.const: Height of the mounted package measured from the board reference surface.

coplanarity.const: Variation of ball contact heights relative to the seating plane.

flatness.const: Deviation of a package surface from its specified reference plane.
